column1: # Default key bindings of the official pack (projects 1.0.0: Minecraft 26.1.2, Fabric Loader 0.19.5),
# read from the client jar and the mod jars with scripts/keys/KeyScan.java (19 October 2026).
# Columns: options.txt name (after "key_"), default key, when it acts, where it comes from.
# When it acts: game (in the world), creative (hotbar save/load modifiers), spectator, debug (only
# with F3 held), recording (only while Replay Mod records; off in the pack), replay (only in Replay
# Mod's viewer, which takes the key over there).
